scope: Offline reader/topology/part-sealing comparison; no runtime, image build or contract change.

reproduce.command: ULPIN_PROFILE=demo TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=apps/api/tsconfig.json BENCH_MODE=before RTT_MS=1 node --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-dir=E:/ulpin-tmp/s5-35 --require ./scripts/platform/isolated-env.cjs --require tsx/cjs E:/ulpin-tmp/s5-35/bench.cjs
reproduce.environment: TMP, TEMP, TMPDIR=E:/ulpin-tmp; repeat with BENCH_MODE=after and RTT_MS=0,1
reproduce.hypothesis: Four scalar SQL round trips per accepted feature dominate elapsed time, not JSON parsing.
reproduce.criterion: At least 3x faster whole read and first sealed chunk within 10s at fixed simulated latency.
reproduce.stop: One bounded before/after comparison, no runtime inference or tuning.

measurementLimits: Database and object storage are in-memory fakes; every topology SQL row returns valid, not GEOS truth.
1ms is an injected delay per SQL statement, not a measured database RTT; actual timer waits are recorded.
The script exercises the actual parser, source checks, scalar/batch SQL protocol and part encoding/hashing.
Publication SQL is audited, not timed; storage verification hashes are exercised but network latency is not.
These results do not prove add-press-to-map under 60s or live PostGIS parity.

profile.finding: Parsing takes seconds offline; 167248 sequential SQL calls explain the order of the observed 236s read.

zeroDelay.finding: No CPU-only speedup; batching adds serialization. The benefit is removed round trips.

realPathPerChunk.topology: Previously 4 SQL statements per accepted feature; now 4 per <=100-record, byte-bounded batch.
realPathPerChunk.normalPublishedSlot: 23 SQL statements including BEGIN/COMMIT, source/attempt pins and outbox; tray refresh and heartbeat add queries.
realPathPerChunk.storage: 1 conditional PUT + 1 verification GET, 4 payload SHA256 computations including encoding; failed PUT replay adds a GET/hash check.

change: StreamingTopologyWriter batches the unchanged scalar PostGIS expressions in source order. Malformed batches and shared timeouts fall back to scalar checks; connectivity and scalar timeouts still retry. Existing part cuts, payload schema and hashes remain unchanged.

earlyParts.mapping: Already supported: intakeLargePhase admits an approved provisional prefix recipe; runChunkMappingJob consumes published slots without raw EOF. Stream lane remains 4.
earlyParts.packages: Unchanged: design INGESTION-ARCHITECTURE.md section 11 row 12 explicitly says packages are drafted only after whole-source hash/receipt and key closure. intakeLargePhase and pairedChunk enforce it; intake-run prepare is queued only after drafting.
earlyParts.designDistinction: Section 6 allows early candidate display/mapping; it does not remove row 12's package/registry closure guard. No new early-mapping gate was needed.

tests: 8 new protocol tests: disposition/hash parity, malformed-batch fallback, scalar timeout, connectivity, byte boundaries, first seal before remaining bytes, quarantined-only batches, existing real fixture in all three framings. Existing streaming/integrity/stale/access suites pass.

checks.inheritedBefore: Backend and Studio typechecks 0; Studio tests 1043 pass/3 skip; OpenAPI and check.py 0 (336 operations,379 schemas). Server log incomplete: two child processes exited 3221226505, no overall exit captured.

openapi.ts --check.reason: Expected stale docs/api/source-pins.json; integration refresh only.

next: Integration refreshes producer pins, then a quiet authorized rehearsal must measure real GEOS/storage contention and add-press-to-map latency; early packages require an explicit design change if still needed.
